verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents a free, one-time Mein ELSTER registration that issues an electronic certificate. That certificate is used to sign and transmit filings and to sign businesses into government online services, which is a credential-based path rather than biometric liveness. The pack does not show that registration and activation can be completed fully remotely, and it never describes a second factor. missing for 10: documented remote activation without a mailed PIN/activation letter or in-person step, explicit description of the MFA factors, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
